fact: The Ministry of Finance and Budget's World Bank-financed contract to produce the target architecture of public finance systems and define an interoperability framework for the Central African Republic was awarded to SIMAC, with notification of award issued on 22 April 2026 for a 5-month contract.
title: Technical Assistance for the implementation of a target global architecture for all public finance related systems: Architecture and interoperability
publisher: World Bank (contract award notice, via BidsFactory)
